scripts.docker:setup: npm run docker:functions:setup && npm run docker:web:setup
scripts.docker:functions:build: docker-compose -f packages/functions/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm functions npm run build
scripts.docker:functions:lint: docker-compose -f packages/functions/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm functions npm run lint
scripts.docker:functions:lint:fix: docker-compose -f packages/functions/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm functions npm run lint:fix
scripts.docker:functions:format:check: docker-compose -f packages/functions/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm functions npm run format:check
scripts.docker:functions:format: docker-compose -f packages/functions/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm functions npm run format
scripts.docker:functions:test: docker-compose -f packages/functions/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm functions npm run test
scripts.docker:functions:test:unit: docker-compose -f packages/functions/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm functions npm run test:unit
scripts.docker:functions:test:integration: docker-compose -f packages/functions/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm functions npm run test:integration
scripts.docker:functions:test:coverage: docker-compose -f packages/functions/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm functions npm run test:coverage
scripts.docker:web:setup: docker-compose -f packages/web/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm web npm ci --ignore-scripts
scripts.docker:web:build: docker-compose -f packages/web/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm web npm run build
scripts.docker:web:dev: docker-compose -f packages/web/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm --service-ports web npm run dev -- --host
scripts.docker:web:lint: docker-compose -f packages/web/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm web npm run lint
scripts.docker:web:lint:fix: docker-compose -f packages/web/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm web npm run lint:fix
scripts.docker:web:format:check: docker-compose -f packages/web/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm web npm run format:check
scripts.docker:web:format: docker-compose -f packages/web/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm web npm run format
scripts.docker:web:test: docker-compose -f packages/web/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm web npm run test
scripts.docker:web:test:coverage: docker-compose -f packages/web/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm web npm run test:coverage
scripts.docker:web:test:integration: docker-compose -f packages/web/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm web npm run test:integration
scripts.docker:web:storybook: docker-compose -f packages/web/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm --service-ports web bash -c 'npm run build:storybook && npx http-server storybook-static -p 6006 -a 0.0.0.0 --silent'
scripts.docker:web:build:storybook: docker-compose -f packages/web/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm web npm run build:storybook
scripts.docker:web:test:visual: docker-compose -f packages/web/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm playwright npx playwright test
scripts.docker:web:test:visual:update: docker-compose -f packages/web/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm playwright npx playwright test --update-snapshots
